body: The fertilizer sack and empty sprayer are tied together. a sharp solvent smell coats one side; a torn strip of road tape covers the other.
title: Fertilizer sack and empty sprayer, the night shift

body: A notebook page is wrapped around a pencil. It counts three people at the door and four after it closed, with the extra tally squeezed into the margin.
title: A quiet inventory in a pocket
